Atlantis NDT ISO 17024 — Personnel Certification Body Alignment 2028

ISO 17024:2012 governs the operation of bodies that certify persons. For NDT inspection contractors, EPC operators, and asset owners running in-house ASNT or ISO 9712 certification programs, ISO 17024 alignment is the gold-standard audit-defensible framework. Atlantis NDT ERP + LMS deliver ISO 17024-aligned program operations from end to end — application + qualification + examination + certification + surveillance + recertification + suspension/withdrawal records.

ISO 17024 Clauses Mapped to Atlantis NDT Workflow

ISO 17024 §4 General requirements (legal + impartiality + financial + management arrangements) → Atlantis NDT ERP organisational records. §5 Structural requirements (committee structure, management responsibility) → governance module. §6 Resource requirements (personnel competence + facilities) → inspector roster + facility audit records. §7 Records + information requirements (confidentiality + retention) → audit-trail per certified person + retention per regulatory rule (typically 7-10 years post-cert-cycle). §8 Schemes (scope + eligibility + exam design + criteria) → scheme manager template. §9 Certification process (application → assessment → decision → cert issuance → surveillance) → state-machine driven workflow.

Dual-Scheme Tracking — ASNT + ISO 9712 + PCN + ACCP + NAS 410 + EN 4179

Atlantis NDT inspector cert roster maintains every scheme an inspector holds — multi-scheme common for global mobility. Example record: Inspector X holds ASNT NDT Level II UT (employer Written Practice per SNT-TC-1A 2024) + ISO 9712 Level II UT (third-party, certified by Lloyd's Register / TUV / BV / DNV) + PCN UK Level II UT (BINDT scheme). Atlantis ERP tracks every cert separately — issue date, expiry, recertification due date, exam-attempt history, retake-grade audit trail.

Automated Recertification Cycle + Reminder Cadence

Recertification calendars per scheme: SNT-TC-1A — employer Written Practice (typically 3-5 yr Level I/II, 5 yr Level III). ISO 9712 — 5 years + retest at 10 years. PCN — 5-year structured exam. ACCP — 5-year. NAS 410 + EN 4179 aerospace — 5-year. Atlantis NDT ERP fires reminders at T-180, T-90, T-30, T-7 days. Lapsed certs auto-flag the inspector as "deployment-blocked" — preventing accidental dispatch of an out-of-cert inspector to a regulated job site.

Audit-Ready Records + Annual Surveillance Pack

Annual ISO 17024 surveillance audit pack auto-generated from Atlantis NDT ERP — population statistics (active certs by scheme + method + level), exam pass rates, recertification on-time rates, complaint records, appeals records, withdrawal records. Atlantis NDT cert-body customers passed their last 3 ISO 17024 + ANSI National Accreditation Board (ANAB) audits with zero findings — vs typical 4-7 findings on spreadsheet-based stacks.
